description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadFilter class, which implements methods for loading filters within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for loading filters of specified types and validating filter types.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadFilter
classes.description: Implements methods for loading and validating filters within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: loadFilter
methods.description: Attempts to load a filter of a specified type and name, registering it if callable or loaded successfully from plugins.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Validates that the filter type provided is among the allowed filter types.
